name: codenav
displayName: codenav — fast C and Python navigation
description: Fast C and Python code navigation with no build configuration.

codenav.binaryPath.description: Path to the codenav binary. Defaults to whatever is on PATH.

codenav.autoIndex.description: Keep the index current automatically: the server watches the workspace and re-indexes on every change, including edits made outside VS Code. Turn off to index only via codenav: Build/Rebuild Index.

codenav.arch.description: Preferred architecture, e.g. x86. Results under other arch/ directories are demoted. Empty means infer from the current file.

codenav.maxReferences.description: Cap on references returned for one symbol. Hot kernel symbols have tens of thousands.
